body.x: QINGDAO, China (AVING) -- <Visual News> Motorola presented its slide smartphone 'MOTORIZR Z6' in China market during SINOCES 2007, which adopted Linux OS. It comes with Bluetooth stereo headphone 'S9' featuring touch sensor. The MOTORIZR Z6 supports a variety of music files such as WMAv10 plus Janus DRM, MP3, AAC, AAC+, e-AAC+, AMR NB, WAV and XMF.
